title: Project Manager
company: SGBI INC - Sastra Global Business Innovations
description:
**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala (Primarily in\-office, with occasional travel)
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About SGBI Inc (Sastra Robotics)** 




 SGBI Inc is a Silicon Valley\-based robotics and AI company operating across the USA, UK and India. We are building next\-generation Physical AI systems that combine AI, robotics, computer vision and intelligent software to automate quality assurance of both software and hardware in smart devices.
 



 Our flagship platform, QUACO (Quality Assurance Companion), enables AI\-driven, robot\-aided testing of Human\-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), bridging the gap between digital intelligence and real\-world systems.
 



 We work with global enterprise customers across industries such as retail, banking, automotive, consumer electronics, avionics and medical, helping them accelerate product validation for complex, hardware\-dependent software and physical products.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a high\-ownership Project Manager to run delivery across our full project portfolio: new product development, software releases, customer deployments and hardware production.
 



 You will be the single point of truth on what is being delivered, by whom and by when. You will plan the work, run the review rhythm, keep our project tools accurate, track and report delivery KPIs, and hold teams and vendors to their commitments, flagging risks to leadership before they become problems.
 



 You will work closely with the founders, engineering leads and our customers and integration partners in the UK, US and Middle East.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Project Portfolio Management** 



* Own the portfolio of active projects across R\&D, software, customer engineering and production.
* Maintain accurate phase, status, priority, milestones, ETAs, dependencies and next actions for every project.
* Publish a clear weekly portfolio view to leadership, with RAG status and the decisions needed.



  





**2\. KPI Tracking \& Reporting** 



* Define and maintain delivery KPIs such as on\-time milestone delivery, schedule variance, overdue task ageing, change request volume, customer issue resolution time, production cycle time and FQC first\-pass yield.
* Build and maintain live KPI dashboards in ClickUp and Excel / Google Sheets, with data that is accurate and up to date.
* Produce weekly and monthly reports for leadership, concise summaries suitable for board and investor updates, and status reports for customers.
* Analyse trends, identify root causes of delays or recurring issues, and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide objective delivery data to support team performance reviews, working with HR.
* Use AI tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT to research, analyse data and prepare clear, well\-structured reports and presentations for stakeholders.



  





**3\. Planning \& Execution** 



* Plan projects from requirement to release using a phase\-gated lifecycle, with defined owners, milestones and deliverables at each stage.
* Maintain the project document checklist for each phase and ensure documents are produced and approved on time.
* Manage scope and change requests, assessing impact on timelines, cost and resources before they are accepted.



  





**4\. Resource \& Capacity Management** 



* Know who is working on what, their next assignment and their expected availability.
* Plan capacity across concurrent projects that share people, test units and equipment, and resolve conflicts early.
* Raise resourcing gaps to leadership with clear options and trade\-offs.



  





**5\. Review \& Governance Rhythm** 



* Run the daily, weekly and monthly review cadence across teams.
* Follow up on overdue tasks and blockers persistently until they are closed.
* Record decisions, actions and owners, and make sure they are carried through.



  





**6\. ClickUp Governance** 



* Own ClickUp as the single source of truth for project work: spaces and lists, task structure, custom fields, status flows, bugs, due dates, dashboards and access.
* Set and enforce usage standards so that status in the tool always reflects reality, including handling of overdue items.
* Build dashboards that give leadership an at\-a\-glance view of delivery health.



  





**7\. Customer Governance** 



* Manage delivery commitments to enterprise customers and integration partners: contacts, milestones, pending actions, change requests and issues.
* Maintain the evidence and communication trail and document trackers for each customer engagement.
* Prepare customer status updates and coordinate deployments, installations and site visits, including international logistics.



  





**8\. Production Coordination** 



* Track the production plan for robot units end to end: materials, procurement, stock, assembly, final quality check (FQC) and shipment.
* Work with Procurement, Stores, QA and Assembly to keep builds on schedule, and manage vendor and lead\-time risks.
* Maintain a production dependency checklist and flag shortages or delays early.



  





**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months** 



* Every active project is visible in ClickUp with accurate status, owners and dates.
* A KPI dashboard is live and reported monthly, and leadership uses it to make decisions.
* The daily, weekly and monthly review rhythm runs consistently, with overdue items actively followed up.
* Every customer commitment is tracked with an owner and a date, and customers receive regular, reliable updates.
* Production builds are tracked from materials to shipment, with risks raised before they cause delays.
* Leadership has fewer surprises: delays and conflicts are flagged early, with options.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* 6\+ years of project management experience, including delivery of technology products that combine hardware and software.
* Proven experience running multiple concurrent projects with shared resources.
* Experience managing delivery for enterprise customers, including change requests and escalations.
* Strong working knowledge of project tools such as ClickUp, Jira or Asana (ClickUp preferred), and of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Hands\-on experience defining KPIs and building dashboards and reports: advanced Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and project tool dashboards.
* Able to turn data into clear, concise insight for senior leadership, not just raw numbers.
* Proficiency in AI tools (essential): confident, day\-to\-day use of tools such as Claude, Google Gemini or ChatGPT for research, analysis, drafting and building stakeholder presentations. This will be assessed during the interview.
* Understanding of hardware production: procurement, lead times, stock, assembly and quality checks.
* Excellent written and verbal English; able to write clear status reports for leadership and customers.
* Firm, persistent follow\-up; comfortable holding senior engineers and vendors to commitments.
* Willingness to take occasional calls outside Indian working hours with UK and US teams, and a valid passport for occasional travel.
* Engineering degree (BE / B.Tech) preferred.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* **Experience in robotics, automation, embedded or electromechanical product companies.**
* **Experience with phase\-gated (stage\-gate) new product development.**
* **Having set up project governance or tooling from scratch in a startup.**
* **Experience working with system integrators or channel partners.**
* **Exposure to ERP systems such as Odoo for stock and procurement.**
* **Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio or Power BI.**
* **PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile / Scrum certification.**



  





**Important Note** 




 This role is suited for someone who
 **drives delivery** 
 , not someone who only tracks it. You will be expected to chase, challenge and escalate, and to own outcomes across teams. If you are looking for a purely coordination or administrative role, this may not be the right fit.
 



 Practical proficiency with AI tools is a
 **core requirement for every role at SGBI** 
 . Candidates without it will not be considered.

title: Project Management Specialist
description:
**Job Title – Project Management Specialist \- Specialist \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 9 \- Specialist**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Agile Project Management**
**Good to have skills: Project Budget Detailing and Resourcing Experience**
**Experience: 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience in project management**
**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Project Manager for delivering IT projects on time, within scope, and within budget. In this role, you will have a strong ownership in ensuring project efficiency by engaging in stakeholder communication, preparing and maintain project plans, identifying and mitigating risks, planning tasks and managing schedules, maintaining documentation, and facilitating communication across teams. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including software developers, QA testers, and business stakeholders to help drive project success in a fast\-paced tech environment.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, and budget
* Lead execution across all project phases including initiation, planning, delivery, UAT, deployment, and closure
* Track project progress using appropriate tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Confluence) and ensure timely delivery
* Own project tracking \- timelines, effort, budget, and burn rates
* Identify variances early and implement corrective actions to minimize delivery risk
* Ensure deliverables meet agreed quality standards through defined acceptance criteria and governance checks
* Support forecasting, invoicing, and financial reporting as required
* Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment
* Provide regular status reports, dashboards, and executive summaries to leadership and clients
* Proactively manage expectations, escalations, and decision‑making forums
* Facilitate effective communication across distributed and cross‑functional teams
* Identify, document, and monitor project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies (RAID)
* Define and track mitigation and contingency plans
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change management process, assessing impact on cost, schedule, and quality
* Ensure all changes are formally reviewed, approved, and communicated
* Coordinate internal and external resources, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and priorities
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies (where applicable) such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and daily standups
* Drive accountability within the team to meet commitments
* Ensure adherence to organizational delivery standards, processes, and compliance requirements
* Capture lessons learned and identify opportunities for improving delivery effectiveness
* Contribute to PMO or practice‑level initiatives such as process improvements, templates, and best practices
* Support mentoring or guidance of junior project coordinators or Scrum Masters where required

title: DE-NCLC-M365 Migration and Modernization Manager-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DE NCLC Manager – Technology Consulting**
 EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a client\-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large\-scale migration or modernization programs.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
* Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.


**Skills And Attributes**
* 9\-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME\-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands\-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target\-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant\-to\-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.


**Soft Skills**
* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high\-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision\-making and problem\-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large\-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
* Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Site Engineer
description:
Location: Kakkanad, Kochi (base office) \- on site, including outstation sites outside Kerala
 



 Experience: 3–5 years
 



 Qualification: Diploma / BE in Civil or Mechanical Engineering
 



  





**About Novelpro Solutions LLP** 




  





 Novelpro Solutions LLP is an engineering consultancy specializing in food and industrial facility projects covering concept design, MEP/utilities integration, civil \& structural engineering, vendor management, and end\-to\-end project execution support for industrial clients.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a Site Execution Engineer with combined MEP and civil execution experience to monitor and drive on\-ground progress across our industrial construction projects. This role sits between design intent and site reality, you'll ensure work is executed on time, to quality standards, and strictly per approved drawings, while coordinating closely with vendors, contractors, and the internal design team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Monitor daily/weekly site progress across civil, structural, and MEP (electrical, HVAC, plumbing/piping, fire\-fighting) work fronts
 



 Ensure execution is strictly as per approved GFC drawings, specifications, and BOQs; flag and resolve deviations promptly
 



 Coordinate and follow up with vendors, contractors, and fabricators to ensure timely delivery and installation
 



 Review and verify quality of civil works (foundations, flooring, structural elements) and MEP installations against standards
 



 Work with PEB (Pre\-Engineered Building) contractors — coordinate erection sequence, anchor bolt/foundation interfaces, and structural fit\-up
 



 Track project schedules, identify delays early, and escalate/resolve bottlenecks with contractors and internal PM
 



 Conduct site measurement checks, material reconciliation, and support bill/RA bill verification
 



 Maintain daily/weekly progress reports, photographic documentation, and update project tracking sheets
 



 Coordinate with design team on RFIs, site queries, and drawing clarifications
 



 Support commissioning\-stage checks and punch\-list closure before handover
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  





 3–5 years of hands\-on site execution experience in industrial/factory construction projects
 



 Working knowledge of both civil and MEP execution (not siloed to one discipline)
 



 Exposure to PEB (Pre\-Engineered Building) structures — erection process, interfaces, tolerances
 



 Ability to read and work off civil, structural, and MEP drawings
 



 Strong vendor/contractor coordination and follow\-up skills
 



 Comfortable with a mixed office \+ travel schedule, including outstation sites
 



 Good reporting discipline — daily/weekly progress reports, photographic documentation, MS Excel/Word proficiency
 



 Problem\-solving mindset with ability to make sound on\-site calls within design constraints
 



  





**Good to Have** 




  





 Prior experience in food processing, pharma, or other hygienic/industrial facility projects
 



 Familiarity with statutory/safety compliance on industrial sites
 



 Knowledge of project management tools (MS Project, Zoho Projects, or similar)
 



 Proficiency in AutoCAD — must be able to prepare/mark up MEP drawings
 



  





**What We Offer** 




  





 Direct exposure to end\-to\-end industrial project execution across multiple sectors
 



 Fast learning curve working closely with design and client teams
 



 Growth path toward project management roles within Novelpro

* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies


**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Demonstrated expertise in BIM Coordination, including clash detection, model federation, and aligning multidisciplinary teams around shared project information.

title: Lead Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 Requirements ownership (approx. 80%)
   

  

* Own requirements end to end for Module 3 enablement — elicitation, documentation, prioritisation, traceability from business objective through to delivered capability and acceptance.
* Act as the translator between HEOR business stakeholders and the AI\&D and platform engineering teams: convert domain and workflow need into requirements the engineers can build against, and convert technical constraints back into decisions the business can actually make.
* Plan and lead requirements definition working sessions and workshops, bringing the Lead AI Engineer in where feasibility needs to be assessed live rather than discovered later.
* Work with business SMEs to surface nuanced requirements that differ across sections and content types, and document them at a level of precision an engineer can act on without a follow\-up conversation.
* Define acceptance criteria for AI\-generated content — factual grounding, source traceability, completeness against the section template, tone and terminology consistency — in terms the business owns and the engineers can test against.
* Build on the substantial documentation already produced through the POC work rather than restarting discovery. Establish quickly what is complete, what remains, and what is at risk.
* Refine requirements iteratively across the execution period as SME review cycles reveal what the platform can and cannot yet do, without losing the thread of what was originally agreed.


 Delivery coordination (approx. 20%)
   

  

* Hold the pod’s delivery cadence: backlog, sprint rhythm, stand\-ups and review cycles, run in the client’s tooling.
* Sequence work realistically against actual capacity and state clearly what can and cannot be delivered within the pilot window.
* Own weekly progress and status reporting to Amgen — at a level of candour that surfaces problems while they are still cheap to fix.
* Identify, log and escalate blockers, risks and dependencies early, particularly those sitting with the core APEX build team, with source\-content availability, or with SME review capacity.
* Maintain the risk, issue, decision and assumption log for the engagement.


 Stakeholder leadership
   

  

* Hold the day\-to\-day relationship with HEOR subject\-matter experts and the wider business group, and be the single point they come to for scope and progress.
* Coordinate across the three organisations involved — HEOR, AI\&D and the platform team — without formal authority over any of them.
* Push back on requirements, scope additions and timeline expectations where the evidence warrants, with reasoning rather than resistance.
* Protect the engineers’ focus: absorb coordination load, filter noise, and ensure they receive requirements that are decided rather than still being argued.
* Document and hand over requirements, decisions and open items in a form the Amgen team can own after the pilot.


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience. 10\+ years in business analysis, business systems analysis or a comparable requirements\-owning role, including a minimum of 3 years on AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent\-automation programmes.
* AI lifecycle fluency. Demonstrable experience across the full AI delivery lifecycle — not a single pilot. Practical understanding of hallucination, non\-determinism, human\-in\-the\-loop requirements and output variability, and how each changes the way requirements must be written.
* Hands\-on GenAI literacy. Working familiarity with GPT/Claude\-class tooling — enough to understand how prompting, templatisation and output structuring work, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about what is and is not achievable.
* Requirements craft. Strong elicitation technique, functional and non\-functional specification, acceptance criteria, and traceability discipline across multiple interconnected workstreams.
* Workshop leadership. Proven ability to plan and lead requirements workshops with senior, non\-technical business stakeholders and drive them to decisions rather than discussion.
* Delivery discipline. Experience running an agile delivery cadence — backlog, sprints, status reporting, risk and dependency management — for a small team.
* Influence without authority. A track record of holding multiple organisations to commitments from outside all of them, evidenced by unblocking programmes rather than documenting them.
* Autonomy. Demonstrated ability to own a workstream and set its working practices without close supervision, in a client\-facing setting.
* Tooling. Proficiency with Jira; familiarity with Smartsheet and SharePoint.
* Communication. Excellent written and verbal English, at the standard required to write for and present to senior commercial stakeholders in the US and Europe, and to disagree constructively.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior delivery within a life sciences, pharmaceutical or biotech commercial organisation — market access, HEOR, medical affairs or commercial analytics. Useful context, but not a screening filter.
* Experience with AI\-assisted document authoring, content generation, knowledge management or large\-scale content transformation.
* Exposure to retrieval\-augmented generation and the requirement implications of grounding and source attribution.
* Familiarity with regulated or GxP\-adjacent documentation environments and their traceability expectations.
* Experience in a self\-directed vendor pod operating alongside, but independently of, a client’s internal build team.
* Formal certification in business analysis (CBAP/CCBA), agile delivery (CSPO, PSM) or project management (PMP).


**Compensation**
 Estimated Pay Range:
   

  

 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

title: Senior Manager – Moulding & Tool Maintenance
description:
**Position:** 
**Senior Manager – Moulding \& Tool Maintenance** 




**Department:** 
 Moulding
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Plant Head
 



**Location:** 
 Cochin, Kerala, India
 



**Position Summary:** 




 Provide strategic and operational leadership for a high\-technology, high\-volume Moulding operation supporting precision electronic connector manufacturing. Lead a manufacturing footprint of 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies with advanced automation.
 



 Own the end\-to\-end performance of the Moulding function, including manufacturing operations, process engineering, automation, capacity planning, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery, while building and managing a robust external moulding ecosystem through vendor development, job work, and purchase models.
 



 Develop a high\-quality, technically capable, cost\-competitive, and scalable moulding vendor network to support business growth, capacity flexibility, localization, and supply continuity. Establish strong technical and commercial governance for outsourced moulding, ensuring consistent quality, competitive total cost, delivery reliability, process capability, and adherence to global manufacturing standards.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. High\-Tech Moulding Operations** 



* Lead a high\-volume Moulding shopfloor comprising 50\+ injection moulding machines, covering vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies.
* Drive performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, OEE, Productivity, Yield, and Capacity Utilization.
* Optimize moulding processes, cycle times, machine utilization, material consumption, changeovers, and process stability.
* Drive advanced automation, robotics, vision systems, process monitoring, and digital manufacturing solutions.
* Establish robust manufacturing standards to ensure consistent and capable processes.



  





**2\. Moulding Vendor Development \& External Manufacturing** 



* Develop and maintain a strategic network of capable moulding vendors to support internal capacity and business growth.
* Identify, evaluate, technically assess, qualify, and develop new moulding vendors based on technology, capacity, quality systems, process capability, scalability, and cost competitiveness.
* Develop vendors capable of meeting stringent requirements for precision electronic connector components.
* Establish structured vendor capability assessment, qualification, process validation, and performance\-monitoring systems.
* Develop alternate sources and a resilient vendor base to mitigate capacity, quality, and supply risks.
* Drive continuous improvement of vendor capability through technical support, process audits, quality improvement initiatives, and performance reviews.



  





**3\. Job Work \& Purchase Model Management** 



* Develop and implement appropriate job\-work and purchase models based on product characteristics, capacity requirements, cost competitiveness, and strategic sourcing considerations.
* Evaluate the optimal make\-versus\-buy / internal\-versus\-external manufacturing approach for moulding requirements.
* Establish clear commercial, technical, quality, and delivery expectations for outsourced moulding.
* Drive cost\-effective external manufacturing without compromising product quality, process capability, IP protection, delivery, or customer requirements.
* Monitor and optimize the overall economics of outsourced moulding, including conversion cost, material utilization, logistics, tooling utilization, and total landed cost.
* Ensure effective capacity allocation between internal operations and external manufacturing partners.



  





**4\. Vendor Quality \& Process Capability** 



* Establish stringent quality and process capability requirements for all moulding vendors.
* Drive First\-Time\-Right, defect prevention, process capability, yield improvement, and reduction of customer\-related quality issues.
* Conduct regular supplier process audits and capability assessments.
* Ensure effective implementation of PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, process validation, and structured problem\-solving at key vendors.
* Lead supplier corrective and preventive actions for quality and delivery issues.
* Establish vendor scorecards covering Quality, Cost, Delivery, Capacity, Responsiveness, and Continuous Improvement.



  





**5\. Cost Competitiveness** 



* Drive a cost\-efficient moulding ecosystem through competitive sourcing, productivity improvement, process optimization, automation, and vendor development.
* Benchmark internal and external conversion costs and identify cost\-reduction opportunities.
* Develop competitive commercial models for job work and purchased moulded components.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to ensure transparency and competitiveness of moulding costs.
* Drive annual cost\-reduction and productivity initiatives across the internal and external moulding network.



  





**6\. Capacity \& Business Continuity** 



* Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term moulding capacity strategies aligned with business growth and customer demand.
* Balance internal capacity with external vendor capacity to provide flexibility, scalability, and responsiveness.
* Establish contingency and alternate\-source strategies for critical components.
* Ensure vendor capacity readiness for new product launches, volume ramps, and demand fluctuations.



  





**7\. New Product Introduction \& Industrialization** 



* Partner with Engineering, NPI, Quality, and Supply Chain teams for successful industrialization of new moulded connector components.
* Assess manufacturability and external manufacturing feasibility during product development.
* Lead vendor selection, capability assessment, trials, validation, and production ramp\-up for outsourced moulding.
* Ensure new vendors and processes achieve required quality, capability, cost, and delivery targets before production release.



  





**8\. Operational Excellence \& Technology** 



* Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Kaizen, automation, and digital manufacturing across internal and external moulding operations.
* Benchmark advanced moulding technologies and global manufacturing practices.
* Promote data\-driven decision\-making and real\-time performance monitoring.
* Drive continuous improvement in OEE, yield, cycle time, scrap, energy consumption, and conversion cost.



  





**9\. People \& Leadership** 



* Lead and develop a high\-performing team across Moulding Operations, Process Engineering, and Moulding Vendor Development.
* Build strong technical capability in injection moulding, automation, process engineering, supplier development, and external manufacturing.
* Develop a culture of accountability, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships with Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and Global Operations.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed institution.
* A postgraduate qualification in Manufacturing, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field is an added advantage.
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in high\-volume injection moulding / plastics manufacturing, preferably within automotive, electronics, electrical, connector, or precision component manufacturing.
* Strong hands\-on and leadership experience in vertical, horizontal, reel\-to\-reel, and over\-moulding technologies, preferably with automated manufacturing systems.



  





**Key Success Measures** 



* Moulding OEE and capacity utilization
* Quality / PPM / First\-Pass Yield
* Internal and external moulding productivity
* Cycle\-time and scrap reduction
* Moulding conversion cost
* Vendor Quality and On\-Time Delivery
* Vendor capability and capacity readiness
* Vendor development / localization
* Job\-work and purchase\-model optimization
* Make\-versus\-buy effectiveness
* New product industrialization performance
* Cost\-reduction and productivity savings
* Automation and digitalization deployment
* Supply continuity and alternate\-source readiness

title: Engineering Head
description:
Difinity Digital is a Data and AI consulting firm delivering solutions across artificial intelligence, data and analytics, and digital engineering for clients in the UAE and Europe, alongside a portfolio of proprietary products.
 



 The Engineering Head holds complete ownership of the engineering function. The role carries accountability for technical strategy, delivery governance, engineering capability and organisational structure, in addition to the architecture and quality of every solution the company builds and deploys.
 



 The position combines functional leadership with continued technical depth. The Engineering Head is expected to set direction, build the team and govern delivery, while remaining sufficiently hands\-on in architecture and technical review to hold authority over engineering decisions.
 



  





**EXPERIENCE: 10\+ years** 




  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Strategy and Function Ownership** 



1. Define the technical strategy for the engineering function across AI, data and analytics, and product engineering.
2. Establish the technology roadmap, platform standards and architectural principles adopted across the organisation.
3. Build and maintain the engineering capability plan, including skill development, team structure and workforce planning.
4. Manage relationships with technology partners and platform vendors and evaluate new tooling and platforms for adoption.
5. Own engineering budgets, tooling investment and infrastructure cost governance.



  





**Delivery Governance** 



1. Hold accountability for technical delivery across all client engagements and internal product development.
2. Establish delivery methodology, engineering standards, quality gates and release governance.
3. Oversee resource allocation, utilisation and capacity planning across concurrent engagements.
4. Monitor delivery health, manage technical and schedule risk, and own resolution of technical escalations.
5. Report engineering performance, risk and capacity to the Director.



  





**Solution Architecture and Technical Requirements** 



1. Own solution architecture and data architecture standards across the organisation.
2. Approve the technical approach, feasibility position and effort estimation for new engagements.
3. Contribute directly to architecture design for complex, high\-risk or strategically significant engagements.
4. Review and approve the technical content of client proposals and statements of work.



  





**Technical Quality and Governance** 



1. Define and enforce code review, design review and security review standards.
2. Maintain final approval authority on architecture decisions and technical debt trade\-offs.
3. Drive the development of reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference implementations.



  





**Organisational and People Leadership** 



1. Lead, structure and scale the engineering organisation across all technical disciplines.
2. Own technical hiring, including role definition, assessment frameworks and interview panels.
3. Establish performance management, career progression paths and technical competency frameworks.
4. Mentor senior engineers and develop the next layer of technical leadership.



  





**Deployment, Security and Compliance** 



1. Ensure all solutions are deployed securely with appropriate access controls, data privacy measures and regulatory compliance.
2. Define governance for AI systems including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, failure handling and cost control.
3. Own production readiness criteria and post\-deployment support standards.



  





**Client and Commercial Engagement** 



1. Represent the engineering function in client engagements requiring senior technical authority, including solution workshops, architecture presentations and escalation management.
2. Support pre\-sales through technical validation, solution design and credibility in client\-facing technical discussions.



  





**3\. Skills and Experience** 




 Candidates are assessed on demonstrated capability and delivery track record rather than years of experience. Depth in every discipline is not expected.
 


1. Proven ownership of engineering delivery for a team or function, with accountability for architecture and quality outcomes.
2. Track record of taking production systems from requirement through to live deployment and ongoing support.
3. Strong, demonstrable expertise in at least one of the following areas: artificial intelligence, data and analytics, or product engineering.
4. Applied experience in artificial intelligence covering machine learning, computer vision or natural language processing, and generative AI including large language model applications and retrieval augmented generation.
5. Applied experience in data and analytics covering data engineering, pipeline design, warehouse or lakehouse architecture, data modelling, governance, and business intelligence.
6. Applied experience in product engineering covering application and product engineering, API and backend service design, enterprise system integration, cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
7. Sufficient working knowledge of the disciplines outside the primary area of expertise to conduct architecture review, validate estimates, assess technical risk and assess technical candidates.
8. Working knowledge of cloud deployment practice, CI/CD, security, access control and data privacy.
9. Understanding of AI governance including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring and cost control.
10. Experience building, structuring and developing engineering teams.
11. Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or client\-facing product environment.
12. Ability to present and defend technical positions to executive, client and engineering audiences.
13. Experience in offshore delivery models serving international clients is desirable.
14. Commercial understanding of utilisation, margin and estimation discipline in a services business is desirable.
15. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification desirable.

title: Solar Project Manager
description:
We are expanding our residential rooftop solar operations across Kerala and need a practical, hands\-on Project Leader based in Kochi. Your main job is to take confirmed residential sales orders (mostly premium 3kW to 5kW residential systems) and get them installed, commissioned, and connected to the grid quickly without compromising on safety or structural quality.
 



  





 You will be actively managing our field supervisors, keeping external installation vendors in line, tracking local inventory, and dealing directly with KSEB to get net\-meters approved and commission solar projects. Prior experience managing residential rooftop solar projects is mandatory.
 



  





**What You Will Actually Do Day\-to\-Day** 
 :
 


* **End to End Project Execution** 
 : Oversee the day\-to\-day deployment of multiple residential rooftop solar projects simultaneously across key Kerala districts. Ensure all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to premium quality standards.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : Manage, mentor, and deploy a distributed team of site surveyors, field engineers, and installation supervisors. Establish strict safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and quality checkpoints.
* **Vendor \& (I\&C) Management** 
 : Build, onboard, and manage a robust network of local Installation \& Commissioning (I\&C) teams and labor contractors. Negotiate rates, monitor daily progress, and audit their workmanship.
* **Procurement \& Inventory** 
 : Coordinate regional supply chain logistics. Manage structural, electrical, and component inventory (modules, inverters, structures, BoS) to ensure zero site\-delivery delays while minimizing local warehousing overheads.
* **DISCOM Liaisoning \& Subsidy paperwork** 
 : Own the relationship with KSEB officials to ensure seamless site inspections, structure approvals, and fast net\-metering synchronization. Ensure error\-free documentation for government subsidy claims.



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 



* **Education** 
 : B.Tech / Diploma in Electrical, Civil, or Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience** 
 : 6 to 10\+ years in solar project management, with at least 2\+ years explicitly leading high\-volume residential or commercial rooftop solar installations.
* **Regulatory Knowledge** 
 : Deep familiarity with Kerala electrical safety regulations, DISCOM net\-metering procedures, and national portal subsidy guidelines.
* **Leadership Style** 
 : A hands\-on operational leader who split time between tracking timelines via project management tools and doing high\-audit site visits in the field.



**What’s in it for You:** 



* A fixed salary matching market standards.
* Performance bonuses tied directly to project turnaround time and zero\-defect quality audits.
* A direct line to the founders and the opportunity to scale our operational blueprint across the region.

title: Operations and Control Tower Lead
description:

 We are looking for an execution\-focused Operations \& Control Tower Lead to manage the operational engine behind our residential rooftop solar deployments.

You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.

 : Revenue, TAT for financial closure, Outstanding collections
* **Metrics you will be tracking** 
 and influencing the org: Dispatch \& Installation TAT, Overall project TAT, Customer NPS

* **Experience**

* **Process Fluency:** 
 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver**

 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. One of the two Senior Consultant vacancies will require demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**

* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.

* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**

**AI\-enabled learning and technology**

* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**

* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.

* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.


**Preferred**
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.

* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.

 business\-level Arabic in reading, writing and speaking is mandatory. The candidate must be able to review proposal content, participate in client discussions, support workshops and interpret business context accurately. Native nationality or ethnic origin is not a requirement.
   

  

* Assessment should include a role\-relevant Arabic writing exercise, proposal review, a short client conversation and workshop facilitation simulation.

**Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change**
 Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role:** 
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio:** 
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

**Capability model:** 
 Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI\-enabled ways of working
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Up to 25% across KSA, UAE and Qatar, engagement\-dependent
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability\-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
   

  

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration\-only position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**
* Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills\-gap reviews and role\-to\-capability mapping.
* Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
* Develop e\-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick\-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
* Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.


**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.
* Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.


**Pursuits, proposals and market support**
* Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
* Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability\-showcase materials.
* Create clear, consulting\-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
* Use business\-level Arabic capability, where required, to review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
* Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
* Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
* Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well\-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
* Arabic business communication: Reads, writes and speaks Arabic at a level appropriate for proposal support, stakeholder interaction and workshop participation.
* AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
* Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
* Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning design, L\&D, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
* Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
* Demonstrated business\-level Arabic proficiency in reading, writing and speaking, sufficient to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops. Proficiency will be assessed through a role\-relevant practical evaluation.
* Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.

 In this role, we are looking for an experienced SAP TRM Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. As an SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) Manager you will oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA treasury solutions, focusing on cash management, transaction management, and risk analysis. They lead teams, manage stakeholder relationships, map business processes, and ensure regulatory compliance for treasury operations.

* Optimize cash management, liquidity planning, bank communication, and hedge accounting.
* Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in TRM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements.
* Provide guidance and support to end\-users during testing, training, and post\-go\-live phases.

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.

* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA TRM Module.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.

* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
* Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
* Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
* Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.
* Candidate should be capable to understand the existing Legacy as\-is application \& business set up and implement in SAP all the sub\-modules of SAP treasury.
* Should participate in BPP workshops, design \& implement solutions in SAP.
* Should provide architectural suggestions on set up and integration between existing SAP \& non\-SAP systems.
* Should be able to lead a team of functional \& technical consultants.
* Should be able to draw up proposals \& plans for the project.
* SAP Certification in Treasury and Risk Management is preferable
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal

* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.

 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

**Job Summary**
 At Accenture Song, delivering high\-quality software solutions is a core value. As a Technical Test Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end testing strategies, driving test automation initiatives, and mentoring the QA team. Your leadership will help ensure quality standards across all aspects of the SDLC—from planning to delivery. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and business teams to align QA efforts with overall project goals.

* Define and own the overall automation testing strategy, ensuring alignment with project and product goals.

* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation framework, environment, configuration, and test data issues to improve execution stability and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to QA engineers by establishing automation standards, coding practices, and testing best practices.
* Monitor automation coverage, execution trends, defect metrics, and overall quality KPIs, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, automation frameworks, tooling, and overall quality engineering practices.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives as part of Agile teams.
* Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, AI\-assisted solutions, and engineering practices to continuously enhance the QA automation capability.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity.

 Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Testing with 15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI\-enabled testing. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large\-scale customer\-facing platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define and lead enterprise and programme\-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and fit\-for\-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end\-to\-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test\-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
* Define and implement CI/CD\-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test\-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk\-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
* Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
* Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test\-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
* Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system\-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
* Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end\-to\-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
* Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk\-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift\-left, continuous testing, and engineering\-led quality practices.
* Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
* Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP\-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high\-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test\-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test\-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI\-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
* Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client\-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
* Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.

title: PMO Lead – Business Transformation
description:
**Job Description: PMO Lead – Business Transformation**




*Full\-time \| Kochi, Kerala* 




**Role Overview** 




  





**Symega is undertaking a company\-wide business transformation program, guided by a leading global strategy firm's blueprint to significantly scale the business over the next five years. To drive execution, we are hiring a full\-time PMO Lead to be the connective tissue between the transformation strategy and day\-to\-day delivery across the organization.** 




**This is not a reporting or coordination\-only role. The PMO Lead will work closely with business unit heads, operations, supply chain, and finance teams to understand the real complexity behind transformation initiatives, identify blockers, and actively contribute to solving them — while keeping the program on track against timelines and milestones.** 




**Reporting Structure** 




**Primary reporting line:** 
 External Transformation Office Lead (engaged consultant, on\-site 3–4 days/month, daily availability via email/calls)
 



**Dotted line:** 
 Director responsible for the Transformation program
 



 This structure ensures the PMO Lead is guided by proven transformation expertise while staying closely connected to the operating rhythm of the business.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**•        Own end\-to\-end tracking of timelines, milestones, and deliverables across all transformation workstreams.** 




**•        Act as the primary link between the external transformation office and internal business teams, ensuring alignment and momentum between strategy sessions.** 




**•        Proactively identify risks and blockers across workstreams and escalate with clear context and recommended options.** 




**•        Run regular stakeholder syncs with business unit heads, operations, supply chain, and finance leaders.** 




**•        Prepare status reports and dashboards for leadership, translating progress into clear, decision\-ready updates.** 




**•        Engage directly with the operational complexity of initiatives — supply chain alignment, capacity expansion, and similar decisions — to genuinely understand issues rather than simply report on them.** 




**•        Partner with business teams on problem\-solving for specific transformation initiatives, contributing analysis and options, not just tracking status.** 
























**Candidate Profile** 




**•        4–6 years of experience, with meaningful exposure to PMO or transformation office roles within a manufacturing organization.** 




**•        MBA from a top\-tier institute, or a well\-regarded Indian institute (e.g., XLRI, XIMB).** 




**•        Strong understanding of how manufacturing businesses operate — candidates from pure services backgrounds are not the fit for this role.** 




**•        Prior experience at the PMO Manager / Senior Manager level, having led a workstream or small team, with the credibility to engage senior stakeholders.** 




**•        Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with comfort operating in ambiguity.** 




**•        Excellent communication skills — able to synthesize complexity for leadership and hold their own in operational discussions.** 




**Tenure \& Growth Path** 




**This role is structured as a 2–3 year engagement tied to the transformation program, giving the incoming candidate a clear mandate and defined purpose. Strong performers who deliver results during this period will be considered for leadership roles within the businesses that emerge from the transformation — offering a genuine path beyond the program itself.** 




**Location** 




**Kochi, Kerala — based full\-time at Symega, with travel as required across manufacturing sites.**
