At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Ernst \&Young LLP**
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 SuccessFactors Employee Central Consultant
   

  

**Reports to (Job Title):** 
 Application Engineer Team Lead
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 (Briefly describe the main objectives and purpose of the job. Why does the job exist? What is it expected to accomplish?)
   

  

 Talent IT Service Delivery team is responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of programs/projects to develop and maintain global applications and systems in Talent IT Landscape in SAP technology stack.
   

  

 The main function of this pillar is to coordinates and manages a team of config resources in SuccessFactors modules and will also have full responsibility for the delivery of projects end\-to\-end working with Project Manager, QA resources and Support Team.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
 (Describe essential functions, or primary duties and responsibilities. Assume the reader does not know the role or function of the job.)
   

  

* Leadership: Ability to inspire, guide, and mentor consultants throughout complex project lifecycles.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Employee Central projects, overseeing all phases from discovery through deployment and support.
* Manage and mentor a team of consultants, assigning tasks and providing guidance throughout project lifecycles.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and resource allocations to ensure deliverables are met on schedule and within budget
* Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to understand business requirements, HR processes, and reporting needs.
* Analyze and document client requirements, translating them into system specifications and design documents.
* Advise clients on best practices, change management strategies, and system adoption approaches.
* Design comprehensive Employee Central solutions, leveraging deep knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors capabilities.
* Configure Employee Central modules, including organizational management, employee data, workflows, business rules, and security settings


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 (Describe the kind of problems and challenges typically faced, and decisions required to perform the job, as well as recommendations made to supervisors or others. Focus on the nature of existing policies, precedents and procedures used to guide decisions, and the degree to which the incumbent is free to make decisions requiring interpretation and judgment. Provide an example.)
   

  

* Challenge/hold the Service Delivery team to account
* Must be able to work within a matrix organization – balancing the needs of the service line against firm initiatives and goals
* Must make decisions, such as prioritize relationships to develop, negotiate with customers and overcome obstacles
* Identify, manage and resolve complex issues, preventing escalations, where possible
* Manage, negotiate and resolve project risks effectively
* Demonstrate, by example, in\-depth knowledge of the EY competency principles and practices, including coaching, learning and mentoring
* Leader and team player – sets example for project managers, business analysts and others to follow
* Create an open, honest, accountable and collaborative team environment


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
 (Describe the knowledge or skills needed to perform this job; these may be technical, managerial or behavioral in nature.)
   

  

* In\-depth technical expertise in SAP Employee Central and ONB 2\.0, covering configuration, design, and data replication processes.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and best practices
* Experience with SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) implementation in highly unionized environments, demonstrating an understanding of unique payroll challenges and requirements.
* Experience of SuccessFactors Employee Central integration with SF Employee Central Payroll (SF ECP), including data management and replication
* Initiates, builds and maintains productive customer relationships
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
* Business Analysis experience
* Basic understanding of data modelling


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 (Describe the level of supervision received (i.e., the frequency of supervisory contact, degree to which the individual acts independently and on what kinds of issues). Describe the level of supervision of others, if any (i.e., assigning work, reviewing performance, direct or indirect responsibility).
   

  

* Direct reports
* Working relationships (daily) with EY ITSD and AMS Lead
* Working relationships (daily) with TCS AMS team
* Liaison to the Business for that Portfolio / App


**Other Requirements:**
 (Describe other functions or expectations of the job such as whether overtime is regularly required (e.g., during busy season?), whether there are particular times of the year that vacation may not be taken, whether there is frequent travel, whether there are any physical requirements beyond those expected in a normal office environment or any other miscellaneous things about the job that should be made known.)
   

  

* International travel may be required
* Fluent English speaker


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 (What is the minimum level of education needed/suggested to perform this job?)
   

  

* A degree in Computer Science and/or a business related degree; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
 (What is minimum number of years needed/suggested to perform this job?)
   

  

* 10\+ years of application services and/or client/supplier relationship management in a technology environment
* 5\+ years experience implementing SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central or equivalent HRIS solutions.
* Strong understanding of global HR processes, data models, and compliance requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with Employee Central configuration, business rules, workflows, and integrations


**Certification Requirements (Good to have):**
 (Describe and explain any certifications and/or licenses needed or helpful to perform this job).
   

  

* Certification in SuccessFactors Employee Central


**Note:**
 This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the job. However, it is not an all\-inclusive listing of the required job functions and functions may vary depending on the particular geographic location of the job and/or the manager. Further, the job description is subject to change at the discretion of management.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager - Business Analysis
description:
**Job Title \- Manager – Business Analysis \- ACS Song**
**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**
**Location: Kochi**
**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**
**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**
**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**
**Educational Qualification** 
 :
 **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**
**Job Summary**
 You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


 Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.

title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer (Senior CRO) - Kochi, Kerala
description:
Are you a data\-driven leader obsessed with finding revenue bottlenecks, optimizing sales funnels, and scaling conversions? UGI is looking for a
 **Senior Conversion Rate Optimizer** 
 to lead our CRO team, optimize admission and repayment performance, and drive operational excellence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As the Senior CRO, you will be responsible for leading our conversion optimization initiatives across lead generation, admissions, and repayment workflows. You will work closely with cross\-functional leadership—including Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations—to audit processes, analyze customer behavior, eliminate lead leakage, and maximize conversion efficiency.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop strategies to improve lead\-to\-admission rates, identify customer journey bottlenecks, and analyze behavior trends across teams.
* Audit sales processes, review follow\-up quality, track executive productivity, and collaborate with Finance/Repayment teams to improve recovery rates.
* Manage and mentor CRO Executives, conduct daily huddles, assign KPIs, and build analytics capabilities across the team.
* Conduct quality audits, track SOP compliance, and build key business intelligence reports (Daily Conversion Dashboards, Branch Performance Reports, Lost Opportunity Analysis, MIS).
* Standardize operational SOPs across branches, implement process automation, and deliver strategic recommendations to senior leadership.



  





**Key Qualifications \& Requirements** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Operations, Commerce, or a related field (MBA preferred).
* **Experience:** 
 4–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Conversion Optimization, Business Analytics, Process Improvement, or Customer Success.
* **Leadership:** 
 Minimum 2 years in a direct team leadership or supervisory role.
* **Technical Proficiency:** 
 Hands\-on expertise with CRM platforms (Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent), Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, dashboard preparation, and sales funnel analytics.



  





  





 If you are an analytical thinker with a proven track record of driving measurable conversion growth, we want to hear from you

title: Senior SAP HCM Consultant
description:
**Job Title: Senior SAP HCM Consultant** 




**Experience: 5\+ Years** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 We are Looking for an experienced
 **Senior SAP HCM Consultant with expertise in Personnel Administration, Payroll, Time Management, Organizational Management, and Indian Payroll statutory compliance** 
 . The role involves end\-to\-end
 **SAP HCM configuration, client interactions, UAT support, S/4HANA migration, and mentoring junior consultants.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Lead design and configuration of HR master data structures — Personnel Areas, Subareas, Employee Groups/Subgroups, and organizational assignments.
* Configure Info types across the employee lifecycle (hiring, transfers, promotions, separations, rehires) and design Personnel Actions and Dynamic Actions.
* Configure enterprise/HR organizational structure and integrate PA with Organisational Management (position management, reporting structure, vacancy management).
* Manage HR data security, including authorization profiles and structural authorisations for sensitive data access.
* Design and configure end\-to\-end payroll processes — schema, PCRs (Personnel Calculation Rules), wage type catalogues, and payroll cycle management.
* Implement statutory compliance for Indian payroll (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Income Tax/TDS, Gratuity, Labour Welfare Fund) and manage off\-cycle and retroactive payroll runs.
* Configure Bank Transfer (DME) processes and integrate payroll with FI/CO (symbolic accounts, posting documents, reconciliation); troubleshoot payroll errors and schema issues.
* Design and configure Time Management — work schedules, holiday calendars, absence/attendance types, counting rules, and quota generation.
* Set up Time Evaluation (schema TM00/TM04\), configure positive/negative time recording, and implement CATS for project\-based time recording.
* Lead requirements workshops and blueprint sessions; produce functional design specs, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and training materials.
* Manage workstreams through go\-live and hypercare , support UAT and cutover activities, and mentor junior HCM consultants.



**Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of SAP HCM functional experience across at least 2 full\-cycle implementations or major rollout projects.
* Full mastery of enterprise and personnel structure (Personnel Area, Subarea, Employee Group/Subgroup, Pay Scale) and comprehensive Infotype knowledge.
* Experience configuring Personnel Actions, Dynamic Actions, and HR workflows, along with structural and role\-based authorisations.
* Integration experience with Organisational Management (OM) and ESS/MSS portals.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on SAP Payroll configuration, including schema and PCR development (reading, writing, and debugging).
* Deep knowledge of Indian statutory payroll — PF, ESI, PT, Income Tax, TDS, Gratuity, and Bonus Act compliance.
* Strong hands\-on Time Management configuration — work schedules, absence/attendance types, counting rules, quota management, and Time Evaluation.
* Experience with S/4HANA migration and payslip design/configuration using SmartForms or SAP Adobe Forms.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with SAP SuccessFactors — Employee Central or Payroll integration (EC\-Payroll).
* Knowledge of HCM for S/4HANA, including the Fiori\-based HR experience and HCM processes on S/4HANA.
* Exposure to international payroll — GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain) or African payroll configurations.
* Basic ABAP reading skills, with the ability to trace payroll schemas and PCRs independently.

**Service line – Manager:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

* Drive RCA and proactive issue prevention
* Emphasis on delivery excellence and service reliability
* Lead a motivated and skilled team of Business Analyst, Application Developers and Technical Architects

* Execute service transition (knowledge transfer, readiness, stabilization) ensuring smooth shift to steady state

* Communication skills (written/oral)
* Willingness to travel


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Certification in ITIL 4 foundation and higher levels, or Lean\-Six Sigma certifications, or Prince2, or PMP from PMI
* Knowledgeable on Java, or .Net or SaaS products (Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP etc)
* Knowledgeable in cloud based products SAP, Azure/GCP/AWS cloud
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of delivery management and transition and practice development.
* Supervise financial management of engagements to deliver value to clients and to the firm.
* Adoption new outsourcing delivery models \& trends.
* Deliver outsourcing programmes, demonstrate expert consulting skills and advanced level of industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to lead outsourcing services assignments.
* People capability development and management for the practice.
* Should be willing to work in shifts and on\-call support.


**What We Look For**
* Demonstrated expertise in leading and growing mid\-scale Managed Services engagements
* Strong experience in stakeholder management, ability in liaisoning, troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with multiple teams with use of complex technologies.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management principles, methods and practices
* Experience Service Designing, Service Transition and
* Confidently articulates Service Management principles and maintains an in\-depth knowledge
* A bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Engineering or similar discipline
* 10\-15 years of experience with minimum 3 years leading mid\-scale Managed Services projects
* Managed muti\-year SOW with contract value ranging from 1\-5 million USD per year
* Managed a reasonably sized team (20\-30 FTEs) across locations, in an onshore\-offshore model
* Experience working in multiple industries preferably Insurance/Financial services/Banking domains
* Executed Application engagements across or one of the technologies \- Java, .Net, Guidewire, Salesforce, SAP products on cloud.

* Solutioning

* Build a strong quality driven and ownership focused delivery culture

* SAP BODS architecture, design, and performance optimization

* ECC to S/4HANA data migration

* IDOC / BAPI based integrations using BODS
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data analysis and issue resolution
* Functional understanding of SAP process areas like Finance, Sales and Distribution, Material Management etc


**Experience in:**
* BODS installation, configuration, scheduling, and Management Console
* Migration mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and cutover execution


**Ability to produce:**
* Migration strategies
* Technical architectures
* Detailed effort estimates and plans
* Good understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL best practices

title: Incident & Change Management Coordinator
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a detail\-oriented, process\-driven professional to build out and mature our Incident Management and Change Management functions. These functions currently exist but lack formal structure\-this role will own the transformation from ad hoc handling to a disciplined, auditable, well\-governed practice. You'll design and implement the processes, approval workflows, and reporting that give engineering, IT, and leadership confidence that incidents are resolved consistently and changes are reviewed, approved, and tracked before they hit production. This is a hands\-on process\-and\-tooling role, not just a policy\-writing one. You'll be expected to build the actual workflows, forms, and automations inside our Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, and related apps) that make the new processes stick.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, IT Infrastructure and Operations.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Incident Management**
* Formalize incident management processes: severity classification, escalation paths, communication protocols, and resolution SLAs
* Own the incident lifecycle in Jira Service Management (or Jira), from detection/logging through resolution and closure
* Drive post\-incident reviews (blameless retrospectives / RCAs), ensure action items are tracked and closed, and report on recurring themes
* Build dashboards and recurring reports on incident volume, MTTR, severity trends, and SLA compliance for leadership visibility


**Change Management**
* Design and implement a formal Change Management process, including change categorization (standard/normal/emergency), risk assessment, and CAB (Change Advisory Board) review cadence
* Build structured Jira workflows and forms to capture change requests, required approvals, rollback plans, and post\-implementation review
* Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams (AWS, M365, Atlassian, and internal platforms) to ensure changes are properly vetted before deployment
* Track change success/failure rates and use data to continuously refine the process


**Tooling, Automation \& Governance**
* Configure and maintain Jira workflows, schemes, automation rules, and Jira Service Management request forms to support both processes end\-to\-end
* Use Atlassian automation (Jira Automation, Confluence integrations, forms) to reduce manual steps\-auto\-routing, approval reminders, SLA breach alerts, ticket linking, etc.
* Maintain Confluence documentation: runbooks, process guides, RACI charts, and CAB meeting notes
* Establish approval workflows and audit trails that satisfy internal governance and any relevant compliance requirements
* Identify opportunities to integrate Incident/Change data with other systems (e.g., monitoring/alerting tools, CMDB\-type asset tracking) as the practice matures


**Cross\-Functional Coordination**
* Act as the process owner and point of contact across engineering, infrastructure, and vendor/contractor teams for all things incident and change related
* Facilitate CAB meetings and post\-incident reviews, keeping them efficient and action\-oriented
* Train and onboard teams on new processes, driving adoption without becoming a bottleneck


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Change Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), or a Project/Program Management role with process\-ownership responsibility
* Hands\-on experience administering Atlassian products\-Jira and/or Jira Service Management required; Confluence experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience building Jira workflows, automation rules, and forms (Jira Service Management request forms or similar) \- this is not just "used Jira," but "configured Jira."
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-aligned incident and change management concepts (formal ITIL certification is a plus, not required)
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to build structure from ambiguity\-you'll be creating a lot of this from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable facilitating meetings with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership
* Data\-oriented mindset\-comfortable building reports/dashboards to show process health and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a technical environment (cloud infrastructure, SaaS, or software engineering organization) is a strong plus, even if you're not an engineer yourself


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification
* Experience with Jira Service Management's Change and Incident\-specific templates/features
* Familiarity with AWS or Microsoft 365 environments (you won't need to administer them but understanding what a "change" looks like in these environments helps)
* Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks where change/incident records are auditable evidence


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.
